actions.content:
# BOS V1 Gate D - Governance Certification

Evidence-only certification. No governance implementation.

Required: backend RBAC; capability policy; procedure/skill policy; limits; scopes; budgets; traceability; least privilege; canonical SQL RBAC evidence where required. Existing Capability/Policy certification is reused but does not by itself close Gate D. Missing evidence fails closed. Production: NO.
